topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Just got the news that Alex is moving across the country. It feels like the ground shifted a little. We've been inseparable for years, through everything. Now, suddenly, there’s this huge distance that’s about to come between us. It’s a lot to take in. I mean, who do I hit up for those late-night talks or sudden coffee runs? Guess I’ll be figuring that out. There’s so much to talk about, so much to say, but where to even start?
